title: PH, UK seek closer cooperation on nature protection, climate efforts
summary: The Philippines and the United Kingdom are exploring expanded cooperation on nature financing, climate resilience and other environmental initiatives, the Department of Environment and Natural…

blocks.text: The Philippines and the United Kingdom are looking at ways to work more closely on protecting the environment, addressing climate change and funding nature conservation projects, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) said.
UK Special Representative for Nature Ruth Davis met with Environment Secretary Juan Miguel Cuna and other DENR officials during bilateral talks to discuss potential areas of collaboration.
Davis said both countries needed to move beyond pilot projects and secure financing to scale up mangrove protection, restoration and other nature-based solutions.

“The challenge for all of us is how we move beyond individual pilots and unlock the kind of financing needed to scale up mangrove protection, restoration, and other nature-based solutions,” Davis said, according to a DENR statement.
She also expressed interest in having British marine science organizations work with their Philippine counterparts.
Cuna said the Philippines faced various environmental threats, including rising temperatures and warmer seas that could harm coral reefs and fisheries.
He welcomed the proposed partnerships, noting ongoing domestic efforts to establish marine research stations and strengthen local scientific capabilities.
“Our priority is to ensure that environmental protection delivers tangible benefits for communities while supporting resilient and sustainable development,” Cuna said.
He added that the Philippines valued its partnership with the UK on climate, biodiversity and ocean issues.
The DENR said the Philippines was also advancing the National Blue Carbon Action Partnership, which is supported by the UK's Blue Planet Fund.
The initiative includes blue carbon mapping, carbon-stock assessments and the development of a Blue Carbon Public Finance Roadmap to guide sustainable investments.— MCG, GMA News
